name.baseName: Printed wiring board, through-hole, lead-containing surface, at plant

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: The functional unit represents 1 m2 of a 2-layer FR-4 PWB, HAL (Sn-Pb) surface finished, with soldermask, for through-hole mount applications, without mounted components. It is designed to be used in industry electronics and simple ICT applications. Process data are taken from environmental reports of 2 German PWB producers, plus from literature. The described PWB has a square weight of 3.08 kg/m2.; UUID: 3a53e50e-7258-386d-8b1a-9672311171f3

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Dataset comprises the following steps of PWB production: substrate preparation, imaging, exposure, etching, sandwiching, via opening, desmearing, activation and accelaration steps as well as via filling, second imaging, exposure, copper plating, cleaning, oxidification, dry vacuum lamination, micro etching, hot air leveling.

# Included processes
The module covers the assembly of a PWB prepared for through-hole mounting of components. In this dataset (raw) materials, infrastructure, energy consumption, emissions to air and water and waste amounts from the production of 1 m2 of board are taken into account. Not included into this dataset is the mounting of the PWB.
